name: @superbee/integration-civic-records
description: Bounded civic discovery, native PDF extraction and dated/undated representation preparation

capability.name: civic_prepare_text
capability.description: Prepare page-linked Markdown from explicitly captured PDF and extracted text. Caller-associated extraction only; no PDF conversion, official-authenticity claim or publication.

capability.name: civic_discover_pdfs
capability.description: Discover bounded same-origin PDF candidates from a captured listing. No network fetch, archive completeness, deletion inference or source authenticity claim.

capability.name: civic_extract_pdf
capability.description: Extract a captured PDF through an explicitly bound pdftotext tool. No direct process spawn, OCR, bundle writes or publication.

capability.name: civic_discover_ecode360
capability.description: Project a captured eCode360 public document-list response into finite selected PDF candidates. No network, identifier enumeration, private records, archive completeness or approval claim.

capability.name: civic_prepare_evidence
capability.description: Prepare source-linked original-byte metadata and complete page-linked Markdown for existing Civic Evidence. Dates remain absent. Supplied associations only; no network, conversion, record/blob writes or publication.

scripts.typecheck: node --check src/operation.mjs && node --check src/capture.mjs && node --check src/ecode360.mjs && node --check src/layout.mjs && node --check src/evidence.mjs
